text:
maria (AM): Quick heads-up — kickoff for OpaqueSystems POC set for Tue 3/8 10:00am PT. Need a short agenda, success metrics, and owners for prompts/evals + infra checks. cc @aj @sam @laura

aj (AE): Got it. Customer is most concerned about hallucination rate on extractive QA, p99 latency under load, and a cost estimate for ~100k tokens/day.

maria (AM): Noted. Stakeholders: Natalie (ML lead), Raj (DevOps), Priya (InfoSec). Natalie joining kickoff.

natalie (Opaque Systems): Hi everyone — thanks for coordinating. Our primary flows: long-doc summarization and private-knowledge retrieval (vector store + model). Success criteria: F1 >= 0.85 on extraction tests, hallucination <= 5% on curated prompts, p99 latency <250ms at ~1k concurrent users. Also need SOC2 evidence and KMS integration details.

sam (ML eng): Sounds good. For hallucination we can run an eval harness using our labeled prompt set. Draft prompt examples below for discussion:

```
# sample prompts (redwood eval harness)
PROMPT_1: "Summarize section 4 of the attached doc in 3 bullets, preserve factual statements exactly."
PROMPT_2: "Given the doc, extract all dates and amounts. If unsure, answer 'UNKNOWN'."
PROMPT_3: "Customer Q: Is feature X available? Answer YES/NO and cite the paragraph."
```

sam (ML eng): I'll own building the prompt/eval harness and the initial ground-truth set. Need sample labeled docs from Natalie.

laura (SRE): A couple infra Qs: do they require VPC/private deployment or is hosted with VPC peering acceptable? Also expected peak qps and typical sequence length (avg tokens per request). That affects batch sizing and GPU selection.

natalie (Opaque Systems): We prefer VPC peering initially; on-prem eventually. Typical requests are 1.2k tokens avg, peak 1k qps (bursty). We'll share a sample traffic trace.

priya (security): We'll need to run the standard security questionnaire. Natalie — who on your side is the security contact? Also: do you enforce BYOK / customer-managed keys?

natalie (Opaque Systems): Priya, that will be me for now. We use AWS KMS and prefer BYOK if available.

securitybot: security questionnaire (link) shared: https://redwood.co/sec/questionnaire. Please complete pre-kickoff where possible.

aj (AE): On pricing: quick sketch — hosted estimate for this load ~ $0.09 / 1k tokens (ballpark) -> ~ $9k/month at 100k tokens/day. Dedicated: baseline commitment + infra ~ $XXk/month but gives predictable latency and data isolation (we can give exact quotes after sizing). I'll prepare a shallow compare for kickoff.

maria (AM): Owners: sam -> evals/prompts/quality checks; laura -> infra sizing, VPC setup; priya -> security questionnaire + KMS details; aj -> pricing/contract. Natalie to share docs and traffic trace.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: Tue 2025-03-08 10:00am PT — https://meet.link/opaque-poc-kickoff. Agenda placeholder created in meeting notes.

laura (SRE): For performance runs I suggest we plan a staged test: (1) small smoke, (2) 10% load for 1 hour, (3) full load soak 4 hours. Need a rollback plan if latency or error rate > threshold.

sam (ML eng): Timeline proposal: Day0 kickoff, Day1 data ingest + vector index sanity, Day3 initial evals (accuracy/hallucination), Day5 perf runs, Day7 handoff + recommendations. We can shorten if we parallelize tasks.

maria (AM): Please add concrete pass/fail criteria in the shared doc before kickoff. Example: hallucination <= 5% on 200 sample prompts, p99 latency < 250ms on 1k concurrent, 99.9% availability during perf run.

aj (AE): I'll attach the commercial T&Cs + PO template after the meeting. Also will surface discount/commit options if they prefer Dedicated.

natalie (Opaque Systems): I'll upload 20 sample docs + traffic trace to the shared drive tonight and invite Raj & Priya. Also will complete security questionnaire first pass.

priya (security): Once we get the sample data I need to confirm that no PHI/PII will be transmitted — otherwise we need DPA amendments.

maria (AM): Good call. Natalie please flag any sensitive fields.

natalie (Opaque Systems): Understood — will mark sensitive docs.

aj (AE): Anything else we need before Tue?

laura (SRE): If possible, share a small subset of raw requests (anonymized) so we can test real seq lengths and caching behavior.

sam (ML eng): I'll draft the initial eval plan and post it in the doc tonight.

maria (AM): Great — thanks everyone. Agenda for kickoff: intros, success criteria alignment, security/infra checklist, sample data handoff, timeline & owners. 30–45m.

natalie (Opaque Systems): Sounds good — see you Tue.

maria (AM): :thumbsup:
